content: Twenty years pouring steel while suits shipped our mills away. These calloused hands, Iron Valley fire — here to restore Valoria to the working class!
130% of GDP. Numbers don't flatter—they indict. Elena Rostova, former Central Bank Governor. Fiscal discipline. Sustainable growth. Arithmetic decides this election.
Forty years defending Valoria. I held the Northern Border when others broke. One final mission: your Commander-in-Chief. Strength at the border. Peace through power.
I turned pocket change into a forty-billion-dollar empire while these folks turned your taxes into debt. Valoria's next CEO just walked on stage.
Arthur Sterling's daughter walked out of his empire with the receipts — now I'm turning dynastic billions into generational revolution. Fund the people. Fund the frontline.
Fifteen million souls know my voice from the pulpit. Tonight, Elijah Haddon steps into the arena—because Valoria's soul needs healing, not accounting.
Eighty hostages came home alive because I read the room before it knew it was being read. Valoria, sit with me. Peace through precision.
Valoria runs on dying code. I built minds that outthink nations — Vivienne Zhao, here to upgrade yours. The Synthetic Century begins tonight.
Valoria knows my name. Thirty-five years, four administrations, every crisis weathered. In uncertain times, choose the steady hand. Tested leadership. Steady Valoria.
Twenty years. Four governors, two oligarchs—convicted. Three car bombs—survived. Valoria's corruption has a prosecutor now. The indictment is coming.
